differences.a_observable: The camera exhibits a shallow depth of field, blurring background and foreground cards.
differences.b_observable: The camera has a deep depth of field, keeping the entire grid of cards in sharp focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field and adjust the aperture to blur the background elements.

differences.a_observable: The white cards have a cooler, blue-gray color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white cards have a warmer, neutral white appearance.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or color grading to add a cooler tint to the white materials.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to match the shallow focus of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Deep, defined shadows beneath the cards provide depth.
differences.b_observable: Faint, diffuse shadows make the cards look flat.
differences.fix: Increase shadow density and ambient occlusion.
